cohort: The study included 68 preterm infants born between 22 and 31 weeks of gestation, divided into groups with and without HCAM.
finding: A predictive score combining umbilical vein leucine-rich a-2 glycoprotein (UV-LRG) and gestational age proved to be a reliable and more useful biomarker for diagnosing histological chorioamnionitis (HCAM) in preterm infants compared to other inflammatory markers.
